data.content_ref: inline:The problem requires deriving a 'prioritized, minimal regression-test plan' covering all six gaps with an 'explicit ordering justified by blast radius.' This target delivers only an isolated test for one gap at Priority 2. More critically, it misapplies the blast-radius taxonomy: it ranks lease-mismatch as 'high but strictly below _reset()' yet it never actually includes the _reset() gap in its plan, meaning the relative ordering it relies on to justify its own Priority 2 placement is structurally undefined within the target. A maintainer reading only this target cannot implement 'test 1 tomorrow morning' because they are not told what test 1 is or why it precedes all others.
